title: Noise-mismatch robustness sweep
rationale: Every calibrated result assumes the filter is told the true sensor noise. Mismatch is not exercised by any case. The sweep pattern already exists (outage_sweep.py is about 200 lines) and the filter sigmas are set in one place (benchmark.py).

title: Benchmark the fault matrix with detection and false-alarm rates
source: Track A exit test; FMEA-lite gaps
rationale: Spoofing, slow GNSS bias, IMU loss, timestamp offset and vision outages are injectable but unit-tested only. Measuring them closes the biggest gap in the FMEA-lite table. The modest-offset-after-outage spoof case is a known open problem, so scope is measure and report, not fix.

title: Fix visual overconfidence structurally (multi-anchor or sliding window)
rationale: Changes the headline result, but the formulation is undecided, ADR-0003 deferred it, and the exit gate (NEES below 10, coverage above 90%) may not be reachable with a NumPy-only filter.

title: Wire the inert bias sigmas and add velocity process noise
rationale: Correctness hygiene. Moves the golden snapshot, so it needs a deliberate regeneration and a review of every published number. Done: the velocity process noise (ADR-0014) and the inert bias sigmas (ADR-0015).

title: Rename the per-second drift keys to per-square-root-second with an alias
rationale: Units bug in names only. Breaking for configs unless an alias is kept.

title: Accelerometer-bias falsification experiment
rationale: Cannot be run honestly while the bias sigma fields are inert.

title: Sensor synchronisation and calibration specification
rationale: Documentation. The timing model and what is measured versus assumed. Feeds P5-02 (timestamp offset).

title: Check the SRS traceability matrix with a script
rationale: The matrix can drift today. A script that fails CI when a requirement names a missing test turns it into a checked claim, which is the pattern this repository already uses for tables.

title: Rewrite the baseline records and fix stale statements
rationale: Records excluded from the public site predate the work. The eskf.py module docstring quotes an old measurement.

title: Release hygiene: provenance attestation and digest-pinned base image
rationale: Closes the not-done list in ADR-0011 before a tagged release.

title: Comparison against an established consistent estimator
rationale: Needs an external reference implementation and a scene export, which strains the zero-dependency rule (S1).

title: Housekeeping: review Dependabot 5, decide on uv.lock, close stale PR 34
rationale: Small but leaves no stale items on the board.

title: Documented fetch path for the TUM VI reference data
rationale: Two tests skip without it. Must not vendor the data (S2).
